messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:

    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-11-25, with Yuki off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]

    earlier: Diego is back on the Cinder on-call rotation as of 2025-11-25, carrying the phone until the next rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]
    earlier: Diego is off the Cinder on-call rotation as of 2025-10-02. [decision; valid 2025-10-02 to 2025-11-25; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-02]
- The reports pipeline went to Boreal as of 2025-06-25, not Ember; Team Ember never owned it, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction]
    earlier: Team Ember owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-06-25, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- Oskar picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego on 2026-06-17. [decision; valid 2026-06-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-17]
- On 2026-03-16, Ember noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-16]
- On 2026-04-29, Ember noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-29]
- Diego has the Ember pager as of the 2026-05-13 cycle, taking over from Oskar. [decision; valid 2026-05-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-13]
    earlier: Oskar has the Ember pager as of the 2026-03-16 cycle, taking over from Diego. [decision; valid 2026-03-16 to 2026-05-13; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-16]
    earlier: Diego carries the Team Ember on-call phone as of the 2026-01-23 on-call swap, until the next rotation. [decision; valid 2026-01-23 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-23]
    earlier: Oskar is on call for team Ember this cycle. [valid 2025-05-28 to 2026-01-23; recorded by standup/ember/2025-05-28]
- Yuki is on team Cinder as of 2025-01-08; Diego left team Cinder for team Ember on 2025-12-15. [valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
    earlier: Yuki and Diego are on team Cinder as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-08]
- The product catalog lived with the Cinder team from 2025-01-17 until 2025-10-20, when it moved to the Boreal team. [valid 2025-10-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-20-catalog]
    earlier: The product catalog lives with the Cinder team as of 2025-01-17. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-10-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- Ember handed the webhooks service to Team Atlas on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-webhooks]
- The authentication gateway is not Team Ember's service. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-17]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-17 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-17]
- The first on-call rotation for team Ember goes to Oskar. [decision; valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-13]
- The Postgres 14 pin on Ledger lifts when the partitioning work finishes. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-30]
- The authentication gateway has a deploy window on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-14]
